mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in federal funds rates signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances during FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate above 3.5% triggers inflation expectations, reducing growth prospects and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive in > 70% of UNRATE crossings above 3.5%, or t-test p-value > 0.05 for returns vs baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in federal funds rates and CPIAUCSL index signal monetary tightening, increasing discount rates on equities and compressing valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive in > 60% of tightening periods, or IC > 0.1 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (industrial output) signals robust demand-side expansion, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: IC < 0.05 over 3-year window when both proxies rise, or returns not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in PAYEMS (labor participation) below 150 indicates labor market contraction, reducing growth momentum and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive in > 50% of contraction periods, or IC > 0.15 over 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising RSAFS (demand) and INDPRO (supply) both indicate balanced growth in economic activity, enhancing corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: IC < 0.05 when both proxies rise, or returns not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 2.0% signals lower labor costs, boosting corporate profitability and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in > 60% of UNRATE drops below 2%, or IC < 0.1 over 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rates alongside industrial production index growth signals expansionary monetary policy supporting supply-side activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: expansionary monetary and supply growth regime
failure_condition: IC < 0.05 when both proxies rise, or returns not statistically significant (p>0.05).
